Owaisi alleges Muslim voter deletion; BJP seeks proof

AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi has alleged that attempts are being made to delete the names of Muslim voters in Hyderabad. He claims that Form-7, a document used for voter list corrections, is being misused for this purpose. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has asked Owaisi to provide evidence for his allegations.
